set.typical_award_size: State Density Bonus Law as implemented in the County Zoning Code Section 6.5.4 (Table 6.4): 20% bonus for 5% very low income rising to 50% at 15%; 20% for 10% low income rising to 35% at 20% and 50% at 24%; 5% for 10% moderate income for-sale rising to 50% at 44%; 80% bonus for 100% affordable projects (up to 20% moderate) with no maximum density within a half mile of a major transit stop, plus a three-story or 33-foot height increase there; separate schedules for senior, special needs, low income college student and land donation. Up to five concessions (Table 6.5: VLI 1 at 5%, 2 at 10%, 3 at 15%, 4 at 16% to 99%; LI 1 at 10%, 2 at 17%, 3 at 24%; five for 100% affordable; one more for child care). Table 6.4.1 (added June 11, 2026) adds a further bonus for projects restricting no more than 50% of units that provide at least 15% very low, 24% lower or 44% moderate income units.
set.audit_note: Spot check Nov 9, 2026: Table 6.4 shows the low income bonus reaches 50% at 24% low income units (35% at 20%), not at 20% as the record stated. Other terms (5-unit minimum, 55-year rental term, concurrent and dispersed units, Affordable Housing Strategies Memorandum, parking Table 6.6) match.

reason: Material: typical_award_size misstated the low income bonus schedule (50% bonus requires 24% low income units, not 20%).
